messages.content: 計算半徑為3單位的球體體積。

function.name: calculate_park_area
function.description: Calculate the total area of a park based on the radius of its circular part. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

radius.description: The radius of the circular part of the park. This is a float type value.

shape.description: The shape of the park. Default is 'circle'.

message.content:
球體的體積公式是 \(V=\frac{4}{3}\pi r^{3}\)。  
將半徑 \(r=3\) 單位代入：

\[
V=\frac{4}{3}\pi(3)^3=\frac{4}{3}\pi \times 27=36\pi
\]

若以數值表示（取 \(\pi \approx 3.14159\)）：

\[
V \approx 36 \times 3.14159 \approx 113.10 \text{ 立方單位}
\]
message.reasoning: The user wants to calculate the volume of a sphere with radius 3 units. They want the calculation. We can use the function calculate_park_area? But that function calculates area of a park based on radius of circular part. It expects radius, units, shape default circle. But we need volume of sphere. There's no function for volume. So we should do it manually. The user didn't specify units. We can assume units are same as radius. So radius=3, units unspecified. We can just compute volume = (4/3)*π*r^3. That equals (4/3)*π*27 = 36π ≈ 113.097. Provide answer.
